findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:662-670: the non-PLAN branch of the title/context-freeze refusal message ("first roll back to PLAN, then run lattice story_advance ... phase INIT") is inaccurate/impossible for the phases where it actually fires. titleContextProtectedPhases (line 651) includes INIT_CHECK, DEV, REVIEW, TEST, DONE. From REVIEW or TEST the machine only allows a rollback to DEV (machine.ts REVIEW/TEST states: START->DEV via canReenterDev), not directly to PLAN -- reaching PLAN needs a second hop (DEV->PLAN via REPLAN) that the message never mentions. From DONE there is NO rollback edge at all (machine.ts: DONE:{type:"final"}), so a title-edit attempt on a DONE story is told to do something structurally impossible. Only the DEV case (single REPLAN hop) matches the literal instruction. Severity medium because the refusal itself still correctly blocks the edit (no invariant break), but the recovery guidance it prints is factually wrong/misleading for REVIEW, TEST and DONE.

packages/main/src/tasks/plan-init-reopen-roundtrip-smoke.ts (whole file) + core/machine.ts canReopenToInitGuard/PLAN.on.REOPEN: checklist CHK-001 declares a must-priority adversarial verification intent (id CHK-001:adversarial:0) that reopen is "refused ... from any non-PLAN phase such as DEV or REVIEW", but no test in the diff (the new smoke only exercises reopen-refused-without-reason from PLAN and reopen-succeeds-from-PLAN) or elsewhere in packages/main/src/tasks exercises story_advance phase=INIT from DEV/REVIEW/TEST. Manual probing (story_advance phase=INIT from an INIT-phase story) only exercises the pre-existing generic self-transition guard, not the REOPEN remap path in transition-orchestrator.ts (which requires story.phase===PLAN to even engage). The guard is structurally correct on inspection (REOPEN is absent from the DEV/REVIEW/TEST xstate on-blocks and from the non-PLAN cases of canSendStoryEventWithoutSnapshotCan), so this is a coverage gap rather than a known defect -- but a declared must-priority adversarial item should have a concrete automated assertion rather than relying on code inspection alone.

CHK-001:adversarial:0 (must) is a compound claim: reopen refused when reason is missing AND refused from any non-PLAN phase such as DEV or REVIEW. plan-init-reopen-roundtrip-smoke.ts lines 162-166 (and its recorded verificationEvidence note) only exercise the missing-reason clause; the story never advances to DEV/REVIEW and attempts a reopen from there, and grep of packages/main/src for REOPEN/canReopenToInit turns up no other test covering the non-PLAN-phase refusal. The switch-case in machine.ts canSendStoryEventWithoutSnapshotCan (case PLAN: only place REOPEN is wired) makes it structurally likely to be correct, but this half of the must-priority intent has zero test evidence and a future refactor of that switch could silently break it with nothing to catch it.
